text: No deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020. Earth-observation data up to 2025 shows no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 ha or larger within the asset. While minor changes (less than 0.5 ha) might have been missed, the evidence confirms no significant deforestation happened during the 2021–2025 period. The asset’s forest cover was already at 0 ha by 2020, according to the JRC dataset.
